entities.name: PRSS8
observations: Prostasin (PRSS8) was increased in placental homogenates in early-onset severe preeclampsia versus late-onset severe preeclampsia and controls; recombinant prostasin inhibited trophoblast invasion and migration in transwell assays.

entities.name: Early-onset severe preeclampsia
observations: In a case-control study, placental prostasin was higher in 19 cases at ≤34 weeks than late-onset severe preeclampsia and normal term controls; observational expression data do not by themselves establish causality.

entities.name: PMID:25078863
observations: Yang et al., J Perinatol. 2015;35:16-22. Recombinant prostasin suppressed trophoblast invasion and migration; prostasin antibody increased MMP2 and MMP9 secretion by HTR-8/SVneo cells.

entities.name: Prostasin invasion effect
observations: In vitro transwell assays showed recombinant prostasin inhibited trophoblast invasion and migration; antibody blockade increased MMP2/MMP9 secretion dose- and time-dependently, supporting but not proving an in-vivo causal contribution to early-onset severe preeclampsia.
